entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: A hard-drinking orphan turned League of Wojek investigator in the Boros Legion; he stopped Szadek, died in Zomaj's plot, and returned as a spirit.

entities.name: Myczil Zunich
entities.description: A veteran Wojek who partnered with Kos, mistakenly killed a little girl, and died falling from a roof.

entities.name: Palla
entities.description: A notorious cultist and gang leader the Wojek hunted in an Orzhov district.

entities.name: Jarad
entities.description: A Devkarin huntmaster and bounty hunter who helped Kos stop Szadek.

entities.name: Feather
entities.description: An angel and Kos's closest partner, who later recruited his spirit as a Wojek officer.

entities.name: Bell Borca
entities.description: Kos's last partner, meant to be his replacement, killed after discovering a conspiracy.

entities.name: Saint Bayul
entities.description: A notable Selesnya Conclave member whose assassination was Kos's first lead.

entities.name: Fonn Zunich
entities.description: Myczil Zunich's daughter, met by Kos during the Bayul investigation.

entities.name: Savra
entities.description: A figure involved in the conspiracy whose death Szadek used to trigger his plan.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: The ancient vampire Dimir leader whom Kos arrested and later trapped in a grounder.

entities.name: Mat'Selesnya
entities.description: The Selesnya guild's consciousness that Szadek planned to kill.

entities.name: Pivlic
entities.description: An old friend of Kos in the Utvara Reclamation Zone.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: A baroness who claimed her inheritance in Utvara and joined Kos against Zomaj.

entities.name: Zomaj Hauc
entities.description: An archmage who tried to hatch dormant dragon eggs and was killed by Teysa and Kos.

entities.name: Vor Golozar
entities.description: A Gruul chieftain who rode a dragon against Zomaj.

entities.name: Crixizix
entities.description: An Izzet League courier whose healing teardrop accidentally killed Kos.

entities.name: Augustin IV
entities.description: The Azorius Grand Arbiter who revived Kos to stop Szadek while plotting to seize Ravnica.

entities.name: Obez Murzeddi
entities.description: A lawmage and ectomancer teamed with Kos.

entities.name: Momir Vig
entities.description: The mad genius Simic guildleader killed by Kos after speaking of Project Kraj.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: The Boros guildmaster who dispatched Kos to the Karlov Manor case.

entities.name: Judith
entities.description: A Rakdos member who trapped Kos in a crystal skull while framing her guildmaster.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: A planeswalker who worked alongside Kos at Karlov Manor.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A young detective who worked alongside Kos.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The guild Kos served as a Wojek officer.

entities.name: League of Wojek
entities.description: The Boros police force in which Kos served.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The guild that bound Kos's spirit as a guard.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: The guild led by Momir Vig.

entities.name: Parhelion
entities.description: A Boros warship piloted by Szadek that crashed into the Azorius guildhall.

entities.name: Agyrem
entities.description: A spectral district under Szadek's control where Kos serves as a spirit officer.

entities.name: The Decamillennial
entities.description: The celebration of the Guildpact where Szadek's plan was stopped.

events.summary: Kos's mother abandons him at the Tin Street Market and he grows up in an orphanage.
events.quote: His mother dumped Agrus in the Tin Street Market as a child of unknown age

events.summary: An unnamed Wojek stops Gruul raiders from burning down the orphanage, inspiring Kos to join the Wojek.
events.quote: they were single-handedly stopped by an unnamed Wojek

events.summary: On Kos's first case Zunich mistakenly kills a little girl used as bait for Palla.
events.quote: Zunich was too eager to get the cultist and mistakenly attacked and killed a little girl

events.summary: Zunich tries to kill Jarad as the sole witness; Kos intervenes and Zunich falls to his death.
events.quote: Zunich slipped off the roof and was killed on impact

events.summary: Kos is forced into a promotion, learning Bell Borca was meant to replace him, and Borca dies after discovering a world-threatening conspiracy.
events.quote: Unfortunately for Borca, that discovery cost him his life.

events.summary: Szadek triggers his plan to kill Mat'Selesnya at the Decamillennial; Jarad and Kos stop it and Kos arrests the Dimir guildleader.
events.quote: Kos arrested the Dimir guildleader to answer for his crimes

events.summary: Overwhelmed by acclaim, Kos retires from the Wojek and becomes an Orzhov security guard in Utvara.
events.quote: he chose to step down from the Wojeks and disappear into the lesser districts of Ravnica

events.summary: Teysa, Kos and allies infiltrate the Cauldron to stop Zomaj's plan to hatch dragon eggs.
events.quote: the group infiltrated the Cauldron to stop Zomaj

events.summary: The group kills the dragon and the archmage, but Kos dies when Crixizix's healing teardrop triggers his condition.
events.quote: he died because of the teardrop Crixizix used, trying to save him

events.summary: Kos's spirit is forced to serve as an Azorius Senate spirit guard, and Augustin IV brings him back to stop Szadek.
events.quote: Grand Arbiter Augustin IV brought him back for the sole purpose of stopping Szadek

events.summary: Kos possesses a Virusoid guard to enter Novijen and kills Momir Vig, too late to stop Project Kraj.
events.quote: Kos was left with little choice and killed the mad genius

events.summary: The Parhelion, piloted by Szadek, crashes into the Azorius guildhall.
events.quote: piloted by Szadek, crashed into the Azorius guildhall

events.summary: Kos traps Szadek in a grounder, then throws it at Augustin, freeing Szadek who kills Augustin by removing his soul.
events.quote: causing Szadek to break out of the container and kill Augustin by removing his soul

events.summary: Feather brings Kos's spirit back as a spirit officer for the Wojek in Agyrem.
events.quote: his spirit was brought back by Feather, who recruited him as a spirit officer for the Wojek

events.summary: During the Karlov Manor case Kos is trapped in a crystal skull by Judith and left there.
events.quote: he was trapped in a crystal skull by Judith
